Qualification attempt — 2026-10-07 (local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007)

PHRF-15 remains open. Removed quadratic voxel-domain setup and per-cell reader index-vector materialization. B0 preparation falls from observed 161.510/151.790 seconds to 1.745/0.888 seconds in final baseline/repaired repeats; this is a source-confirmed complexity repair with exploratory before/after timings, not controlled benchmark medians.

At V=100000, N=300, 8 workers and 256-voxel blocks, final baseline attempts 56992 in 120.067 execution seconds and emits none. Repaired multistart attempts 404 in 122.274 seconds (56 decoder accepted, 276 Boundary, 72 CurvatureNotPositive); no complete block is delivered before cancellation. N=1200, V=10000 attempts 32 Boundary refusals in 147.754 seconds. Deadlines are checked between voxels; workers are drained. Original-family certification is excluded and unavailable. No full workload time is extrapolated.

Process heap sampling is not engine live memory. The source-based simultaneous-reference scenario at N=1200 reaches 256.85 MiB with eight first-order references or 321.04 MiB with eight full-jet references, before excluded scratch, blocks, metadata and headers. Actual engine peak, complete certified timings, fixed-shape denominators, JS throughput and crossovers remain unresolved. Host is M2 Pro/macOS15.1.1/JDK21/Node24, not the frozen reference host.

Final gates: dataset 76 JVM / 62 JS; targeted workflows 8 JVM / 8 JS; compiler warning-clean. Existing main-discovery warning only. No hosted CI, publication or epic closure. Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-qualification-20261007/README.md and certification-audit.md; 41 source/artifact hashes verified.

---

Retained prior scope and acceptance

Current assessment — 2026-10-05

Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: The current ML path now charges residual-row/basis/nuisance visits and additional worker scratch. Old component timings and the 256-voxel warm helper cannot qualify its complete workload. No new performance campaign was run during consolidation.

Fresh context: Yes: performance qualification.

Next action: Use the actual decoded output/certification path after PHRF-33 and scientific admission; retain equivalent fixed-shape denominators, complete phase/work/memory accounting, frozen host and >=5 repetitions. Report JS separately and all unmet targets.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-pilot-integration-20261004.md; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md; PHRF-33 acceptance.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them. Status, priority, assignee, claims and dependency edges are unchanged.

---

Previous scope and history (acceptance retained)

Roadmap refinement 2026-09-13: repeated qualification uses the actual integrated decoder/readout/certification path from PHRF-33 after the scientific domain is admitted by PHRF-14.

Run >=5 measured repetitions after documented warmup on the frozen host; retain median/p95, raw per-run work/counters, source/provider/JDK/Node/heap/thread/power configuration, attempted/accepted counts, memory/allocation/GC and whole-process RSS. Include preparation/certification/whitening/pooling/projection/decoding/terminal-curvature/readout/Float32/IO times without double counting. C0 <=30 s and B0 <=120 s / <=256 MiB apply to the declared original workloads. Compare exact fixed-shape and one-/two-reference modes using equivalent acquired input and output; preserve <=12x and <=24x ratios alongside absolute results.

Measure declared V scaling (10000/20000/100000 where required), N=300 and N=1200 declared stress cells, sparse/dense schedules and worker/block-size bounds on JVM; report actual JS throughput separately. Do not infer a full-scale pass from a smaller stress cell. A change to decoded work or accuracy invalidates reuse of the old 30.422/48.198-second cells as complete-workload evidence.

Wire PHRF benchmark execution into the existing scheduled/manual first-level performance workflow or an explicit bounded PHRF task with uploaded raw receipts. tools/ci/first-level-benchmark.sh currently compiles fit benchmarks but does not run ConditionProfileBenchmark or TrialBandedBenchmark. Keep wall-clock thresholds off ordinary noisy unit CI; require their reference-host receipt for qualification. Record every unmet target explicitly; no relaxed scientific tolerance to win speed.

---
Prior implementation criteria retained for traceability (the dated scope clarification above governs where it differs):

Scope restated. Acceptance:

- Absolute C0 (`<= 30 s`) and B0 (`<= 120 s`, `<= 256 MiB`) cells filled on
  the frozen host with complete work counters and separate preparation,
  pooling, certification and IO totals; ratios reported alongside.
- `TrialBanded` sparse/dense bandwidth crossover and `N` scaling; JVM and JS
  throughput; unmet targets stay unmet with recorded disposition.
- No finite-state measurements unless PHRF-10 was opened at the PHRF-07
  checkpoint.

Revision 2 (2026-09-10): docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items-v2.md; review: docs/plans/profile-hrf-review.md; spike evidence: docs/plans/profile-hrf-spike-results.md; scientific plan: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md.
